    Assay and omics result tibbles

    Source: R/classes-vctrs.R
    bio_results.Rd

    Results from the assay, bioprocess and omics functions are tibble subclasses. A <bio_assay> carries its fitted standard curves or kinetic models, and a <bio_omics> carries the settings and prior estimates of a differential expression or enrichment analysis. The metadata is used by tidy(), glance(), augment() and autoplot(), and is kept through dplyr verbs while the required columns are present.

    Usage

    new_bio_assay(x, assay, meta = list(), required = character())

is_bio_assay(x)

new_bio_omics(x, analysis, meta = list(), required = character())

is_bio_omics(x)

    Arguments

    x

    A data frame (constructors) or any object (predicates).

    assay, analysis

    A string naming the kind of result, for example "dose_response" or "diff_expr".

    meta

    A list of metadata.

    required

    Columns that must be present for the class to be kept.

    Value

    The constructors return a <bio_assay> or <bio_omics> tibble. The predicates return a single logical.

    Examples

    fit <- bio_dose_response(dose_response_sim, dose, response, .by = compound)
is_bio_assay(fit)
#> [1] TRUE
fit |> dplyr::arrange(ec50) |> is_bio_assay()
#> [1] TRUE

x <- new_bio_assay(tibble::tibble(id = 1:2), "custom", required = "id")
x
#> # A bio_assay: custom: 2 x 1
#>      id
#>   <int>
#> 1     1
#> 2     2
